states.loadSession: Load a session to start coaching.

badges.experimentalCaption: deterministic, on-device — figures may shift as the analysis is tuned
badges.advisoryCaption: scrubbing & unused-grip reads come from a GPS-derived friction circle (lateral g ≈ v²·κ) — directional, not absolute; a chassis accelerometer would sharpen them

sections.delta: Where the time goes (delta to best)

baselineSetup.note: Frozen from the baseline lap — no live setup is assigned, so no diff is shown.

map.legend: Corners are coloured by attributed cause (dashed = low-confidence / advisory). Cyan ring = geometric apex · dashed purple = apex offset · green dot = exit onto a straight (grey = none). Tap a cause or overlay below to show/hide it; click any marker; toggle a satellite background top-right.

breakdown.onBestPace: On your best pace through here.

quality.note: Scrubbing / unused-grip reads are GPS-derived (lateral g ≈ v²·κ) and advisory; confidence is capped by GPS quality. A chassis-mounted accelerometer would sharpen them — many kart loggers mount the sensor on the steering, which isn't ideal for this.

takeaway.noLaps: No complete laps to analyse yet.
takeaway.oneLap: One clean lap so far (best {{best}}) — bank a few more to read your consistency.
takeaway.inconsistent: Your pace is there — best lap {{best}} — but you're losing ~{{gap}}s per lap to inconsistency; tightening that up is your biggest gain.
takeaway.tight: Tight session — laps within ±{{stdev}}s of each other. Pace, not consistency, is where the time is now.

insight.inconsistent_apex: Corner {{corner}}: losing ~{{secs}}s — your minimum speed here swings about {{swing}} (1 sigma) lap to lap. Repeating the same line and speed is the bigger gain than chasing more pace.
insight.scrubbing: Corner {{corner}}: losing ~{{secs}}s — scrubbing speed through the slow point (sliding under lateral load rather than rolling through). Likely too much steering/early apex.
insight.unused_grip: Corner {{corner}}: losing ~{{secs}}s — apex looks under the grip limit (~{{util}}% of demonstrated), so there's room to carry more speed.
insight.low_min_speed: Corner {{corner}}: losing ~{{secs}}s — about {{gap}} less minimum speed than your best.
insight.low_min_speed_exit: Corner {{corner}}: losing ~{{secs}}s — about {{gap}} less at the apex onto a straight, so it compounds down the following straight.
insight.corner_execution: Corner {{corner}}: losing ~{{secs}}s with apex speed matching your best — the loss is in entry/line/exit (needs more channels to pin down).
